paras: ARD (ADRO Racing Division) is ADRO's motorsport engineering program, built for drivers who demand more from their car on track. Every ARD component is developed through CFD simulation and track tested before anything reaches a customer. Scott, ADRO's Head of Aerodynamics, brings an F1 development background to every ARD project. The GR Supra ARD Aero Package is the one of the first full systems to come out of that program.

Most front splitters are flat panels. They add some visual aggression, generate a modest amount of downforce at the nose, and leave everything else to chance. The ARD front splitter is designed around a different idea: that the front of the car isn't just a downforce source — it's the starting point of a complete aerodynamic strategy that has to be managed all the way to the rear diffuser.
